segments.title: Great Lethal Off: Pre-Match Hype & Technical Setup
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast in full competitive fervor, assembling the Cream Team (Exterminator, Kassem G, Fiona Nova) for a 4v4 Lethal Company showdown against Show Boba's; Kassem's mod installation issues delay practice.

segments.title: Great Lethal Off: Practice Runs & Rules Negotiation
segments.notes: Cream Team runs vanilla practice rounds to learn turret patterns and fire-exit routing; a Discord call with Show Boba's (Gina Darling, Avali May, Ian, Razz) establishes 90-minute vanilla rules, screenshot scoring, and podcast-appearance stakes.

segments.title: Great Lethal Off: Live Tournament Gameplay
segments.notes: Two lobbies compete simultaneously; Cream Team prioritizes rapid planet-hopping and entrance-loot efficiency while Show Boba's struggles with turret deaths and Razz's mid-match power outage; Case anchors comms from the ship.

segments.title: Great Lethal Off: Score Verification & Victory
segments.notes: Chaotic post-match math session across Discords yields Cream Team 4,087 vs Show Boba's 3,883; Gina Darling concedes, jokingly disbands Show Boba's podcast rather than host Fiona Nova per wager terms.

segments.title: Great Lethal Off: Modded Victory Lap
segments.notes: Case re-enables mods (Goku Bracken, jump-fix) for casual community play; Kendelle joins, recounts sister's physical disdain for Case, and the crew decks out the ship before a raid send-off.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the Great Lethal Off from the newsroom desk, captains the Cream Team to a narrow vanilla Lethal Company victory over Show Boba's.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Joins the post-victory modded session, reveals her sister once choked Case and tripped him into a brick wall.

lore_notes.fact: Kendelle's sister has a history of physical aggression toward Case (choking, tripping into brick wall).
Case filmed Turbo Tax segments at Santa Monica Pier, encountering language-barrier rejections.
Show Boba's podcast kayfabe-dissolved after losing the wager rather than host Fiona Nova.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors the Great Lethal Off, a 90-minute vanilla Lethal Company tournament where the Cream Team edges Show Boba's 4,087 to 3,883 after a frantic screenshot audit. The loss triggers a kayfabe shutdown of the Show Boba's podcast, and the broadcast closes with a modded victory lap featuring Kendelle and community regulars.
